facts: 1) CONFIRMED — The searched state is only cargo/formation q_F=(x_F,y_F,psi_F). SearchKey contains only integer x/y/psi bins; SearchNode contains q_F plus parent/cost/action and mode/gear hints. Vehicle body headings theta_i, A/O/S modes, and body-Spin reconfiguration are not search-state dimensions (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_search.cpp:19-49,256-262; catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/include/fwis_v3_planner/formation_search.hpp:1-4).

1) CONFIRMED — Deduplication bins are llround(qf.x/xy_res), llround(qf.y/xy_res), and llround(qf.psi/yaw_res). psi_F is not wrapped before binning, so headings separated by 2*pi occupy different bins. Defaults are xy_res=0.20 m, yaw_res=rotation_step_rad=0.17453292519943295 rad (10 deg), translation_step_m=0.50 m, goal_xy_tol_m=0.15 m, and goal_yaw_tol_rad=0.15 rad; all are ROS-param configurable (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_search.cpp:79-83; catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/include/fwis_v3_planner/formation_search.hpp:17-27; catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_planner_node.cpp:124-148).

1) CONFIRMED — The requested goal psi_F itself is kept as a continuous value, not snapped to a goal bin. Expansion creates a shortest-direction rotation toward wrap_angle(goal.psi-qf.psi), clipped to rotation_step_rad, plus fixed +rotation_step_rad and -rotation_step_rad probes. A node becomes a goal candidate inside both configured near-goal tolerances, after which the exact connector is required (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_search.cpp:145-161,344-355). Signed negative dpsi is preserved by integration as psi_F+=dpsi; no curvature is computed in this front end (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/include/fwis_v3_planner/formation_model.hpp:90-103).

2) CONFIRMED — Along every searched path and collision sweep, rigid_bodies(qf) uses theta_i(qf)=vehicle.start_theta+(qf.psi-request.start_qf.psi). Translation therefore leaves every theta_i unchanged; cargo rotation changes every theta_i by exactly the same delta psi_F. It does not literally set theta_i=psi_F and it preserves initial inter-vehicle heading differences, but it does impose rigid co-rotation rather than independent heading trajectories (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/include/fwis_v3_planner/formation_collision.hpp:293-303,382-395).

2) CONFIRMED — Vehicle centres in bodies_at are exactly x_i=qf.x+cos(qf.psi)*offset_x-sin(qf.psi)*offset_y and y_i=qf.y+sin(qf.psi)*offset_x+cos(qf.psi)*offset_y, with the independently supplied heading assigned to the OBB (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/include/fwis_v3_planner/formation_collision.hpp:417-431). Request validation also enforces both start and goal centres against p_F+R(psi_F)r_i with default position_tolerance_m=1e-6; goal_heading_free explicitly does not relax goal centres. Offsets arrive in the request rather than being hardcoded in these C++ files (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/include/fwis_v3_planner/formation_model.hpp:209-210,299-330; catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_planner_node.cpp:70-85).

2) CONFIRMED — goal_clear() does not use the rigid_bodies endpoint formula: goal_bodies() evaluates bodies_at(request.goal_qf, goal_headings()), and goal_headings() returns each vehicle.goal_theta verbatim. It then performs static map/self-OBB clearance with zero padding. There is no goal_heading_free branch, so a free vehicle's supplied goal_theta is still its sole collision-checked terminal orientation (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/include/fwis_v3_planner/formation_collision.hpp:289-306,408-415). The flag is copied from ROS at formation_planner_node.cpp:82 and stored at formation_model.hpp:48, but is otherwise unused by the checker/search.

2) CONFIRMED — goal_heading_free never releases cargo psi_F or centre positions: candidate acceptance and exact connection always use request.goal_qf.psi and request.goal_qf.x/y, while centre rigidity is validated separately (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_search.cpp:210-249,344-355; catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/include/fwis_v3_planner/formation_model.hpp:310-329).

3) CONFIRMED — connect_exact_goal tries translation-then-rotation first (rotate_first=false) and rotation-then-translation second (rotate_first=true). Translation is the remaining world-frame position error rotated into the current formation frame; rotation is wrap_angle(goal.psi-pose.psi) about the default explicit pivot (0,0), i.e. the current cargo origin. Zero residuals below 1e-10 skip that primitive (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_search.cpp:210-242).

3) CONFIRMED — Each appended exact-connection primitive must pass sweep_clear; the completed candidate must then have position error <1e-7 m and abs(wrap_angle(endpoint.psi-goal.psi)) <1e-7 rad and pass full_sweep_clear from request.start_qf. These are geometric OBB map/self-collision sweeps under the rigid-heading convention, not dynamic certification (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_search.cpp:192-205,234-249; catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/include/fwis_v3_planner/formation_collision.hpp:328-395).

3) CONFIRMED — Neither exact connection nor expansion checks per-vehicle A/O/S equations, body-Spin events, steering/actuator limits, timing, speed, acceleration, jerk, or dynamic feasibility. mode_hint affects only a switch cost during expansion and gear_hint is merely recorded; neither is used to certify connect_exact_goal. Success is explicitly published as GEOMETRY_ONLY_UNCERTIFIED with certification=GEOMETRY_ONLY, not FEASIBLE (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_search.cpp:396-425; catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_planner_node.cpp:227-229; catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/include/fwis_v3_planner/formation_search.hpp:1-4).

4) CONFIRMED — When search_formation_geometry returns failure, the node publishes no new /formation/plan_seed. It publishes a latched std_msgs/String on /formation/status with schema=formation_frontend_status/v1, node_state=GEOMETRY_SEARCH_FAILED, certification=NONE, search_started=true, trajectory_published=false, executable=false, plan_id equal to the raw request plan_id, and reason/detail copied from the search result. Terminal search reasons include START_FORMATION_COLLISION, GOAL_FORMATION_COLLISION, FORMATION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, and FORMATION_NO_GEOMETRIC_PATH (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_planner_node.cpp:117-119,218-225,252-313; catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_search.cpp:281-291,432-443). The seed publisher is also latched, and the failure path sends no empty seed to replace an earlier latched seed (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_planner_node.cpp:117-119,221-227).

4) CONFIRMED — A valid request arriving before a valid map is cached in the single pending_request_ slot, and the node publishes /formation/status with node_state=MAP_UNAVAILABLE, reason=MAP_UNAVAILABLE, certification=NONE, search_started=false, and the same plan_id. Before any map callback map_error_ is empty, so detail is empty. A subsequent valid map resets the slot and replays the request through on_request; this increments requests_seen_ a second time. A later pre-map request overwrites the earlier single slot; an invalid request is rejected rather than cached (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_planner_node.cpp:189-210,329-336).

The former near-goal tolerances of 0.15 m/0.15 rad are therefore not, by themselves, sufficient to emit a seed. Attribution of such a runtime seed to stale/different running code or another producer is SUSPECTED, not established by this read-only audit (catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_search.cpp:223-249,349-364; catkin_ws/src/fwis_v3_planner/src/formation_planner_node.cpp:232-245).
